author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding A by the three black keys, shifted patterns, a repeating theme, octaves, steady speeding up and quiet-to-loud playing, with Grieg's troll music.

classes.title: Creep up: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
classes.goal: Find A by the three black keys and creep up fingers 1 to 5.

mathTarget.parentLine: A hides inside the group of three black keys

classes.parentPrompt: Find three black keys with your child; the thumb goes on the white key A among them.
classes.childAction: Thumb on A, then creep up: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
classes.bridge: A is the troll hall's door, tucked inside the three black keys.

intro.caption: Shh... find the troll door
intro.parentCue: point to a group of three black keys

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding A and creeping fingers 1 to 5.

classes.title: Sneaky black keys
classes.goal: Learn the black-key part: the same little shape, then one tiny step lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little pattern, moved one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the black key first, then let your child play the shape.
classes.childAction: Play the black-key shape, then the same shape a tiny step lower.
classes.bridge: Black keys are the troll's shadows; the shadow steps one key to the left.

intro.caption: The troll's black-key shadows
intro.parentCue: point to D sharp, the black key

games.caption: Quiet now: shadow shape
games.parentCue: Whisper 'quiet now' as your child plays

games.caption: Tiptoe slow: one step lower
games.parentCue: Same shape, one key to the left

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same shape, shifted one key lower.

classes.title: Again and again
classes.goal: Play the whole tune slowly and hear how the creeping line keeps coming back.

mathTarget.parentLine: One short tune comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Tiptoe two fingers on your child's arm each time the creeping line starts again.
classes.childAction: Play slowly. Each time the creeping line returns, whisper 'again!'
classes.bridge: Grieg's short theme repeats again and again, like trolls creeping round the hall.

intro.caption: Here it comes again!
intro.parentCue: tiptoe your fingers each time it returns

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a theme that repeats.

classes.title: Jump to high A
classes.goal: Practise the jump from E up to high A, the same note as your thumb's A.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same note name, one house higher on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Play low A, then high A; ask your child 'same name?' before they jump.
classes.childAction: Creep up to E, then jump the hand to high A.
classes.bridge: Low A is the troll hall; high A is the same hall, up the mountain.

intro.caption: Low A, high A: same name!
intro.parentCue: play both As for your child first

games.caption: Two As, two houses
games.parentCue: Point low, then high, with each sound

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: jumping to the same note, higher.

classes.title: Troll boots on one
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note on the first beat of each bar of four.

mathTarget.parentLine: Count four beats; the low note always lands on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and count 'one, two, three, four' out loud, stomping softly on one.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays one low troll boot on every one.
classes.bridge: Low notes live on the left: big heavy troll boots, one per bar.

games.caption: Find the low notes
games.parentCue: Point to each low key first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting bars of four, landing on one.

classes.title: Boots below, tiptoes above
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low note per bar: one hand holds, the other creeps.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note holds while eight quick notes creep above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'boot' on each low note. Go slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand holds the boot while the right hand tiptoes.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the sleeping troll; right hand tiptoes past without waking him.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: both hands on the keys, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two different jobs.

classes.title: Faster and faster
classes.goal: Play both hands again and again, a little faster each time, like Grieg's music.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each time a little faster, step by step, not all at once

classes.parentPrompt: Tap the beat on your knee a little quicker each round; go back to slow if messy.
classes.childAction: Play it slow, then quicker, then quicker. Too fast? Slow down.
classes.bridge: The trolls wake up and chase: each time round, a little faster.

intro.caption: The trolls are waking up!
intro.parentCue: speed up a tiny bit each round

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: speeding up step by step.

classes.title: Race through the hall
classes.goal: Play the whole tune along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Tiptoe your fingers on your knee beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep racing!
classes.bridge: Grieg wrote this for a play, when Peer finds himself in the troll king's hall.

intro.caption: Race through the troll hall!
intro.parentCue: tiptoe your fingers on your knee to help

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: Quiet start, big finish
classes.goal: Play for teddy: start very quiet, grow louder each time, and finish big.

mathTarget.parentLine: Getting a little louder each time, step by step

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; crouch low at the start, rise a little each round.
classes.childAction: Start with whisper fingers, then grow louder each time round.
classes.bridge: Quiet notes are trolls tiptoeing; loud notes are the whole hall waking up.

intro.caption: Shh... teddy, the trolls are coming
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: growing from quiet to loud, a whole song.
